Platform patient ID. Options: MARIA_SD_001, PAT-0042, PAT-0087, PAT-0103, PAT-0156

Ordering provider NPI for financial clearance and evidence record.
Reviewer identity for PAS human-gate approval.

WSO2 IS authorize endpoint. e.g. https://localhost:9453/oauth2/authorize. Leave blank for Tier A+ (HAPI FHIR + dev-mock auth).
